GitHub Issue: Post Date: 2021-07-15T15:41:35Z Current Date: April 4 2025 Title: Unable to override `service` using command option Description: In my previous projects I was configuring the name of the service using a command option. This let my team each deploy their own stack using a unique CF stack name. This was done by setting `service: ${opt:serviceName, 'default-service-name'}`. Since version 2.32.0, when attempting this, the commands fail with the following error: `Cannot resolve serverless.yml: "service" property is not accessible (configured behind variables which cannot be resolved at this stage)`. If I switch to using an environment variable instead of a command options (`${opt:....` to ${env:....`) then it will succeed.
